text:
Alex: Quick API Q — streaming deltas for chat + tool/function calls. Do we guarantee chunk ordering semantics for function calls? ie, will clients always see: delta(text), delta(function_call.start), delta(function_call.args... ), delta(function_call.finish)?

Maria: Short answer: we guarantee ordering across deltas but not hard chunk boundaries. Practically that means a runtime can split arg payloads arbitrarily.

Sahil: To be safe for backward compat, we should avoid changing existing tokens. My suggestion: add an optional additive field on delta events, something like `event_type` (values: message, func_start, func_chunk, func_end) and a `func_id` GUID so reassembly is deterministic for clients that opt-in. Old clients ignore it.

Jenna: Example sketch of a streaming delta payload (proposal):

```json
{"delta": {"content": "Here is the answer so far"}, "event_type": "message"}
{"delta": {"name": "get_user_profile"}, "event_type": "func_start", "func_id": "f7b3"}
{"delta": {"arguments": "{\"user_id\":\"123\"}"}, "event_type": "func_chunk", "func_id": "f7b3"}
{"delta": {"finished": true}, "event_type": "func_end", "func_id": "f7b3"}
```

Alex: Nice — this keeps existing fields intact and is strictly additive. Two follow-ups: 1) should `event_type` be on every delta or only when non-message events occur? 2) what's the rollout plan so Dedicated/Private runtimes don't break?

Maria: I think default should be: include `event_type` only when the delta is NOT a plain message chunk. That minimizes noise for simple streams. Rollout: spec PR + feature flag for runtime; start as opt-in for *new* model versions.

Sahil: Ops note — Dedicated clusters need a capability check in the agent. If runtime sees unknown `event_type` it should be a no-op. We'll add a unit test that simulates an old client ignoring the field.

deploy-bot: PR ping: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/842> — spec draft attached.

Jenna: I'll review the spec PR after lunch and leave CR comments. If everyone agrees, we can merge opt-in flag behind a config `stream_event_type=true` and then enable for canary.

Alex: Sounds good. TL;DR: proposal = additive `event_type` + `func_id` for reassembly, opt-in rollout, tests to prove old clients unaffected. Thanks — tagging @Maria @Sahil for follow-ups and PRs. :thumbsup:
